derivation: perhaps from H837 (אֹשֶׁר) and H410 (אֵל); God has arrived;
def: Ithiel, the name of an Israelite, also of a symbolical person

occurrences.text: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
